title: Personalized w-Event Privacy for Infinite Stream Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.09054v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In applications such as event monitoring, log analysis, and video querying, $w$-event privacy protects individual data within a sliding time window while supporting accurate stream statistics. Existing studies on infinite data streams mainly assume homogeneous privacy requirements for all users, which cannot capture user-specific privacy preferences. This paper studies personalized $w$-event privacy for private data stream estimation. We first design the Personalized Window Size Mechanism (PWSM), which supports personalized privacy requirements at each time slot. translated_title: 面向无限流估计的个性化w-事件隐私
translated_abstract: 在事件监控、日志分析和视频查询等应用中，w-事件隐私在滑动时间窗口内保护个人数据，同时支持准确的流统计。现有的无限数据流研究主要假设所有用户具有同质的隐私需求，这无法捕捉用户特定的隐私偏好。本文研究了用于私有数据流估计的个性化w-事件隐私。我们首先设计了个性化窗口大小机制（PWSM），该机制支持每个时隙的个性化隐私需求。基于PWSM，我们提出了个性化预算分配（PBD）和个性化预算吸收（PBA），以在$\boldsymbol{w}$-事件$\boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}$个性化差分隐私（($\boldsymbol{w}$, $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{E}}$)-EPDP）下估计流统计量。PBD保证为下一步预留的预算不小于b
tldr: 本文提出个性化w-事件隐私框架，通过PWSM机制和预算分配/吸收策略，在无限流估计中满足用户特定隐私需求，同时保持统计准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a personalized w-event privacy framework with PWSM and budget distribution/absorption strategies to satisfy user-specific privacy needs in infinite stream estimation while maintaining statistical accuracy.
